name: Monitor Indeed and LinkedIn jobs in Google Sheets with Apify

parameters.content:
## Who is this for?
Recruiters, staffing teams and job-board builders who need a small recurring feed of job listings in Google Sheets.

## How it works
Search Indeed (default) or LinkedIn using Apify, fetch up to 20 jobs and save URLs not already in your sheet. The workflow validates responses and includes manual and daily 09:00 UTC triggers. No AI subscription is needed.

## Setup
1. Create a sheet tab named **Jobs** with headers: `jobUrl`, `title`, `company`, `location`, `jobBoard`, `collectedAt`.
2. Edit **Search settings** with your spreadsheet ID, role, US location and boards.
3. Connect Google Sheets credentials to both sheet nodes.
4. Connect Apify Header Auth: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Store it only in credentials.
5. Test manually twice. Set your timezone and schedule before publishing.

## Requirements and limitations
Requires n8n, Google Sheets and Apify credits. We develop the [paid Actor](https://apify.com/groupoject/indeed-jobs-scraper?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=jobs_to_sheets); this template is free.

Each request caps Actor charges at $0.10. Repeated searches can still incur charges. Automatic request retries are disabled; inspect Apify Runs after timeouts. Run one execution at a time. URL changes can create duplicates, and coverage is not exhaustive. Email/Slack alerts are not included. Configure an n8n error workflow before scheduling.

## Apify authentication and costs
Create a **Header Auth** credential for the HTTP request:
- Name: `Authorization`
- Value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`
Keep the real token in credentials, never in exported JSON.

Each request caps Actor charges at **$0.10**, output at **20 jobs**, and Actor runtime at **120 seconds**. Results may be fewer than 20. Repeated runs can charge again for jobs collected even when Sheets deduplication suppresses them.

Automatic request retries are OFF. After a timeout, inspect Apify Runs before manually retrying. Source-specific outcomes are in the run storage.

Actor: [Multi Job Board Scraper](https://apify.com/groupoject/indeed-jobs-scraper?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=jobs_to_sheets)
We are its developer; this is not an official job-board API.

## Enable only after testing
The imported workflow is inactive. Schedule: **09:00 UTC daily**. Change timezone in workflow settings and the hour in the Schedule Trigger, then publish/activate in n8n.

Run one execution at a time. Google Sheets read-then-write is not transactional. For high-volume use, use a database with a unique job URL constraint.

A valid empty dataset writes no rows. Invalid responses stop before writing. If the Sheet write fails, fix the credential/headers and inspect saved rows before retrying. Existing URLs are used for deduplication; Actor-side onlyNewJobs is intentionally disabled.

Configure an n8n error workflow for notifications. Email/Slack alerts are not included. Job URLs can change; cross-board deduplication is not guaranteed.
